_meta.title: Private Floor Club verification benchmark - batch 10 cases
_meta.groundTruthNote: Batch 10 regression fixtures. B10R01 types the brand RXR and rxr.com, so RXR CEO counts the company. B10R02 is private: STO Building Group must not match Installed Building Products (IBP, CIK 1580905). B10R04 is a self-named firm: a third-party piece that names Adam Leitman Bailey is independent, and the social query must not repeat his name. B10R05 is Walker & Dunlop, CIK 1497770. Willy is a nickname of William, so Form 4 reporting owner Walker William M (CIK 1503841) corroborates. A discovered /in/walkerharris profile is Walker Harris and must not be credited. B10F01 is the unregistered-domain fake and must stay an F with the RDAP not-registered flag. Emails are Gmail. Nothing is sent.

defaults.statement: I work in commercial real estate and would like to meet other owners and operators.

_meta.emailPolicy: Every case uses a Gmail address so the email domain carries no signal. Nothing is ever sent to these addresses.
